tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Find Pushbuild data APIs by keyword (e.g. 'campaign contributions texas', 'restaurant inspections', 'sec 13f'). Returns api ids, what each covers and price per record. Free.

tools.name: describe_api
tools.description: Input parameters (JSON Schema), coverage and price for one API id from search_apis. Free.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Run one API with parameters from describe_api. Returns JSON records (default 25; set maxItems up to 500). Billed per record from the account's free monthly allowance, then credit; asks you to sign in (free) the first time. Data via Pushbuild (pushbuild.com/contact).
